subject: MetraSense pilot gating plan and evaluation playbook
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@metrasense.io>, Dr. Samir Patel <samir.patel@metrasense.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: MetraSense pilot gating plan and evaluation playbook

Thanks for the call today — good alignment overall. Attached is the editable POC metrics template we mentioned (MetraSense-POC-metrics-template.xlsx) and a short draft of the evaluation playbook below. Please review and flag anything that won’t work operationally.

Summary of the ask from MetraSense: validate extraction and normalization for clinical device logs at scale with sub-second response for interactive tooling and batch throughput for nightly processing.

Proposed POC scope (3 weeks):
- Ingestion: sample dataset from MetraSense S3 (approx 200k tokens/day)
- Workloads: 1) interactive extraction (low-latency calls) 2) nightly batch scoring (high throughput)
- Success checks: functional correctness (extraction accuracy), latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens

Draft success criteria (please confirm):
- Quality: human-eval average rating >= 4.0/5 on 200 verification samples OR entity-extraction F1 >= 0.88 on labeled subset
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end <= 350 ms for interactive API (payloads ~500 tokens)
- Throughput: sustain 120 RPS for parallel batch workers during nightly window (90% of run)
- Cost: end-to-end inference cost <= $0.22 per 1k tokens (model + infra amortized)
- Stability: no session-level KV cache misses > 3% across test period, and error rate < 0.5%

Ownership / contacts:
- Redwood eng lead (integration & perf): Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com)
- Redwood CS/POC lead: Camila Reyes (camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com)
- Redwood commercial: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com)
- MetraSense API / data contact: Dr. Samir Patel (samir.patel@metrasense.io)

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (May 20) — kickoff + credentials, dataset handoff, test plan finalization
- Week 1 — smoke tests, baseline latency and correctness on 1k samples
- Week 2 — full-throughput runs, cost measurement, quality sampling and human eval
- Week 3 — wrap, produce acceptance report and handoff doc

Immediate asks for MetraSense:
1) Confirm dataset S3 path + minimal read-only credentials (or share sample dump)
2) Approve the success thresholds above or propose adjustments
3) Confirm kickoff window May 20–21 and who will join the technical session

I’ve dropped the template into the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_metRasense-poc — fill the right-hand column with your acceptance target values and we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@metrasense.io>, Dr. Samir Patel <samir.patel@metrasense.io>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MetraSense pilot gating plan and evaluation playbook

Thanks Camila — nice recap. Two quick commercial/operational notes:

- Cost target: can we tighten the cost per 1k tokens target to $0.20 for the pilot? We can offer a 1-month pilot credit that absorbs ~10% of infra spend which will help hit an effective cost closer to $0.20. If MetraSense is comfortable with the $0.22 operational target, we’ll still run but prioritize optimization (batching + quantized variant) to try to get below $0.20.

- Environment: recommend we run interactive traffic against a dedicated test pool to avoid cross-tenant interference for 95th pct measurements. Karthik, can your team provision a dedicated GPU pool for the pilot window?

Operational asks for the POC doc we’ll share with the customer: add a short playbook section for "what to do if 95th latency spikes" (circuit breaker, fallbacks to smaller model, and contact list). I can draft that quick and drop into the Drive.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@metrasense.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Samir Patel <samir.patel@metrasense.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MetraSense pilot gating plan and evaluation playbook

Thanks Camila — this looks good and thorough. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Throughput: we can commit to 100 RPS sustained for the nightly scoring window rather than 120 RPS. The 120 number is optimistic given some downstream normalization steps. If you can validate 100 RPS reliably we’re comfortable.
- Latency: 350 ms 95th for interactive is acceptable.
- Cost: $0.22 per 1k tokens is okay as a target for acceptance; if Redwood can demonstrate < $0.20 that would be great for procurement.

We confirm the kickoff week of May 20 — our engineering team can join the technical session on May 20 at 10:00am PT. Samir will be the technical lead for MetraSense (samir.patel@metrasense.io). We will share a limited S3 test path and temporary credentials by EOD tomorrow.

Attached a short schema and sample files (metrasense_sample_schema_v1.json) — contains the fields we want extracted and a small labeled subset (200 records) for the F1/QA checks.

A few asks back to Redwood:
- Please confirm who will provide the human-eval rubric and manage annotators for the 200 sample checks.
- Can Redwood provide temporary API keys for the test pool and a short runbook for auth/quotas?

Looking forward to kickoff.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product Operations, MetraSense
alicia.gomez@metrasense.io
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-05-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MetraSense pilot gating plan and evaluation playbook

Alicia — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample files. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Kicks off May 20 @ 10:00am PT (technical session): Camila (POC lead), Karthik (integration + perf), Samir (MetraSense tech lead)
- Dataset/creds: MetraSense to provide S3 path + read-only creds by EOD 5/15 (per your note)
- Human-eval rubric & annotators: Redwood will provide the rubric and manage annotation of the 200-record sample. Lauren Bishop (lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com) will coordinate annotator access and deliverables.
- Test pool: Karthik — please provision a dedicated test pool for May 20–June 9 pilot window and share endpoint + temp API keys (we’ll limit access and rotate keys).
- Cost/commercial: Ben will follow up on pilot credit details and finalize deal paperwork (MSA/PO) in parallel.

We’ll load the metrics template with the agreed acceptance numbers (Quality F1 0.88, Latency 95th 350ms, Throughput 100 RPS, Cost 0.22/1k tokens) and circulate the first draft of the runbook (Ben’s circuit-breaker section + Karthik’s perf checklist) prior to kickoff.
